kids_rhymes.label: Kids Nursery Rhymes
kids_rhymes.notes: WARNING: 'Made for Kids' (COPPA) disables personalized ads and comments, so RPM is very low. This is a pure volume game (top channels earn on hundreds of millions of views). YouTube actively demonetizes low-quality mass-produced AI kids content — quality bar is HIGH. Highest-risk niche of the four.
